titulo.es: Every screen on Earth shows a countdown. Except yours (Part 1) ⏳
titulo.en: Every screen on Earth shows a countdown. Except yours (Part 1) ⏳

descripcion.es:
Every screen on Earth turns red and starts counting down. Yours says something else.

Fiction. Part 1.

#story #whatif #countdown
descripcion.en:
Every screen on Earth turns red and starts counting down. Yours says something else.

Fiction. Part 1.

#story #whatif #countdown

texto.es: At three oh seven a.m., every screen on Earth turns red.
texto.en: At three oh seven a.m., every screen on Earth turns red.

texto.es: Every screen, except yours. Yours shows a single word. Stay.
texto.en: Every screen, except yours. Yours shows a single word. Stay.

texto.es: Day one. People panic. Highways fill up. Everyone is leaving the city.
texto.en: Day one. People panic. Highways fill up. Everyone is leaving the city.

texto.es: You look at your phone again. Stay.
texto.en: You look at your phone again. Stay.

texto.es: Day two. The stores are empty. Your neighbor pounds on your door.
texto.en: Day two. The stores are empty. Your neighbor pounds on your door.

texto.es: Come with us, he says. You almost do.
texto.en: Come with us, he says. You almost do.

texto.es: Then your screen changes. Do not open the door.
texto.en: Then your screen changes. Do not open the door.

texto.es: You look through the peephole. Your neighbor is standing there. Perfectly still. Smiling.
texto.en: You look through the peephole. Your neighbor is standing there. Perfectly still. Smiling.

texto.es: And his phone is not counting down anymore. It shows your name.
texto.en: And his phone is not counting down anymore. It shows your name.
